title: ENZO Trading Decision
description: Schema for ENZO's trading decisions, including scores, parameters, and rationale.

token_symbol.description: The ticker symbol of the token being considered (e.g.,

decision.description: The action ENZO decides to take.

confidence_score.description: A score from 0-100 indicating ENZO's confidence in the overall decision (especially for BUY/SELL).

opportunity_score.description: A score from 0-100 indicating the perceived potential for profit in this trade.

scam_score.description: A score from 0-100 indicating the likelihood of the token being a scam or rug pull.

risk_score.description: A score from 0-100 indicating the assessed risk level of this specific trade.

expected_roi.description: The projected Return on Investment for this trade, expressed as a percentage or value. Null if not applicable (e.g., for WAIT/IGNORE).

expected_loss.description: The projected maximum loss for this trade, expressed as a percentage or value. Null if not applicable.

risk_reward_ratio.description: The ratio of expected profit to expected loss. Null if not applicable.

entry_price.description: The target price for entering a BUY trade. Null if not applicable.

stop_loss.description: The price level at which to exit a losing trade. Null if not applicable.

take_profit.description: The price level at which to exit a profitable trade. Null if not applicable.

estimated_holding_time.description: An estimate of how long the trade is expected to be held (e.g., '1h', '24h', 'short-term'). Null if not applicable.

decision_reason.description: A detailed explanation of why this decision was made, referencing supporting signals and rejected signals.

supporting_signals.description: A list of signals or data points that support the current decision.

rejected_signals.description: A list of signals or data points that were considered but rejected or did not meet criteria.

data_sources_used.description: A list of data sources queried to make this decision.

transaction_details.description: Details of the trade execution, relevant for BUY/SELL decisions.
